messages:
anya: Proposal: 'tile-granularity' config to let loaders pick between tensor-aligned ranges, fixed tiles, or bisection. Reason: different workloads favor different shapes.

 tom: sounds useful. How would config be set? per-model manifest or runtime heuristic?

 anya: both. manifest key loader.tile_granularity = [tensor, tile:1MB, bisection] and runtime can override when a policy detects thrash.

 li: edge cases: tiny tensors will be inefficient with 1MB tiles. Need min/max rules and auto-shrink for micro-tensors.

 anya: agreed. algorithm: if average tensor size < tile/8 then switch to tensor mode for that shard. Also add 'tile_compaction' during indexing to pack small tensors into shared tiles.

 tom: metrics to watch?

 anya: tile.read_ops, range.fetch_ops, stitch_overhead_ms, first_token_p50/p95, prefetch_bytes.

 ops-bot: note: feature-flag 'tile-granularity' currently disabled in prod.

 li: ok please add small RFC follow-up with migration notes & indexer changes.

 anya: will do, opening ML-2099. Thanks.
